Bug_Title: Synchronization should not be done on instances of value-based classes
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the generated code by synchronizing on instances of the value-based class Integer. Both 'a' and 'b' are instances of Integer with the same value, and thus they refer to the same cached object in memory. This can lead to incorrect synchronization behavior where locking on 'a' and 'b' does not behave as expected.

Both 'a' and 'b' are instances of Integer with the same value, leading to incorrect synchronization behavior.
